page.overview:
Who is 7 cultists?

These 7 doctors are characters as well as antagonists in .

The seven doctors are seen talking with Terence Wynn, before entering the room preparing for an operation. However, after a short while after they have suited up, Michael enters the room with a large surgical blade and begins murdering all of them. A doctor's face is bashed against the window, one is choked and stabbed, most of them are brutally thrown, bashed and murdered. Later, an injured doctor tries to escape, but to no avail.
